items.title: 14.7 S.H.M mein conservation of energy (energy ka bachao) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.7 with Figs 14.10-14.11 and Example 14.5 timed from the mean position (PDF 31-34).

blocks.text: S.H.M karne wali body ke paas potential energy (P.E.) bhi hoti hai aur kinetic energy (K.E.) bhi. P.E. mean position se hatne (displacement) ki wajah se hai aur K.E. velocity ki wajah se. Jhoolte waqt dono badalti rehti hain, lekin agar friction (ragar) na ho to total energy (kul energy) har instant (lamhe) constant rehti hai.

Fig. 14.10 ka mass-spring system lein. Jab mass ko mean position O se hataya jaye to restoring force F lagti hai: mean position (x = 0) par yeh zero hai aur extreme position (x = x₀) par sab se zyada. Is liye mean se extreme position tak force ki average (ausat) value:

blocks.alt: Support se teen spring latke hain. Pehle par mass natural length (asal lambai) par; doosra mazeed l khinch kar mean position O tak, jo laal dashed line hai; teesra mean position se mazeed xo neeche khincha hua. Har mass ke neeche teer us ka weight dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.10: Spring par mass natural length, mean position aur extreme position par (kitab ki Figure 14.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Displacement = 0 par force = 0; displacement = x₀ par force F = kx₀. Is liye:
Spring ko maximum displacement x₀ tak kheenchne mein jo work (kaam) hota hai, woh average force × distance hai:
Yeh work spring mein potential energy ban kar store (jama) ho jata hai, jise elastic potential energy kehte hain. Kisi bhi displacement x par P.E.:
Eq. (14.22) se saaf hai ke P.E. x = 0 par zero aur x = ±x₀, yani dono extreme positions par, sab se zyada hai; wahan saari energy elastic P.E. hai:
Force hatane ke baad mass velocity v se chalne lagta hai. S.H.M mein instantaneous velocity:
ω = √(k/m) rakhne se:
Mean position (x = 0) par velocity sab se zyada hoti hai:
Is liye kisi bhi displacement x par mass ki kinetic energy:
Mean position (x = 0) par P.E. zero hai aur velocity sab se zyada, is liye wahan saari energy K.E. hai:
Kisi bhi displacement x par total energy K.E. aur P.E. ka sum (jor) hai:
Upar ki K.E. aur P.E. rakhne se:
ω = √(k/m), yani k = mω². Ise Eq. (14.28) mein k ki jagah rakhein:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Eq. (14.29) ko T.E = ½kmω²x₀² chhapa hai, yani k bhi reh gaya aur mω² bhi aa gaya. k = mω² rakhne ka matlab hai k ki jagah mω² likhna, is liye sahi T.E = ½mω²x₀² hai (units bhi isi se joule bante hain).

Equations (14.23), (14.27) aur (14.28) se prove (sabit) hua ke mass-spring system ki total energy constant hai aur amplitude ke square ke directly proportional hai (amplitude dugna to energy chaar guna). Energy ke conservation (bachao) ka yeh law har S.H.M karne wali body par apply hota hai. Jab mass centre (mean position) se guzarta hai to K.E. sab se zyada aur P.E. zero (x = 0); aur jab mass extreme position par ho to P.E. sab se zyada aur K.E. zero (x = x₀).
Energy K.E. aur P.E. ke darmiyan aati jaati rehti hai, lekin dono ka sum constant rehta hai. Yeh Fig. 14.11 ke graph mein dikhaya gaya hai, jis mein displacement ke muqable K.E., P.E. aur T.E. hain.

blocks.alt: Displacement X (-xo se xo tak) ke muqable energy. Potential energy P.E. parabola hai, 0 par zero aur dono siron par sab se zyada. Kinetic energy K.E. ulta parabola, 0 par sab se zyada aur siron par zero. Total energy T.E. horizontal dashed line hai. Teer woh do points dikhate hain jahan K.E. aur P.E. barabar hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.11: S.H.M ke liye displacement ke muqable energy (K.E, P.E aur T.E) ka graph (kitab ki Figure 14.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke graph mein X-axis ke dono siron par 'x₀' likha hai; baen sira −x₀ hai, aur khaake mein yahi likha hai. Graph mein kisi bhi point par K.E. aur P.E. ko add karein (jorein) to jawab hamesha T.E. ki seedhi line ke barabar aata hai: total energy constant hai. Darmiyan (x = 0) par saari energy K.E. hai aur siron par saari P.E.

blocks.title: Example 14.5
blocks.problem: 0.010 kg ki body 6 s period se S.H.M karta hai. Mean position se guzarne ke ek second baad us ki velocity 0.06 m s⁻¹ hai. Us ki kinetic energy, potential energy aur total energy nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: m = 0.010 kg, T = 6 s, mean position se guzarne ke t = 1 s baad v = 0.06 m s⁻¹.
Waqt mean position se gina ja raha hai, is liye x = x₀ sin ωt aur v = x₀ω cos ωt.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne v = x₀ω sin(ωt) aur sin(π/3) = 0.866 le kar x₀ = 0.066 m, Eᴛ = 2.4 × 10⁻⁵ J aur P.E. = 0.6 × 10⁻⁵ J nikala hai. Yeh formula waqt ko extreme position se ginta hai, jab ke sawal kehta hai ke waqt mean position se guzarne ke baad gina jaye. Mean position se ginein to v = x₀ω cos(ωt) lagta hai aur sahi jawab x₀ ≈ 0.115 m, Eᴛ ≈ 7.2 × 10⁻⁵ J aur P.E. ≈ 5.4 × 10⁻⁵ J hai (K.E. dono soorton mein 1.8 × 10⁻⁵ J).

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: (i) P.E. ko P.E. = ½kx² = ½mω²x² se bhi nikal sakte hain, jahan x us waqt ka displacement hai, jo kitab ke mutabiq x = x₀ cos ωt se nikalta hai (yahan waqt extreme position se gina jata hai). (ii) Total energy Eᴛ = K.E. + P.E. se bhi nikal sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Agar S.H.M ka amplitude dugna kar diya jaye to total energy ka kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Chaar guna ho jayegi, kyun ke total energy ½kx₀² amplitude ke square ke proportional hai: (2x₀)² = 4x₀².

blocks.text: Short summary (mukhtasar khulasa)

items: P.E. = ½kx² (extreme par sab se zyada); K.E. = ½k(x₀² − x²) (mean position par sab se zyada).
T.E. = ½kx₀² = ½mω²x₀²: constant aur amplitude ke square ke proportional.
Energy K.E. aur P.E. mein badalti rehti hai, jor wahi rehta hai (Fig. 14.11).
